name: Cloudflare Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: Enables the deployment of remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Cloudflare Workers without requiring authentication. It allows users to define custom tools and connect to clients like Claude Desktop or Cloudflare AI Playground using Server-Sent Events.
